line: A wise word lands today. Write it down before the next meeting starts.
Rainy-day thinking suits you. Your best idea turns up on the bus home.
People look to you today. Lead the meeting and keep it under 30 minutes.
A small deadline pinches today. Start early; skip the second coffee break.
Steady wins today. Finish the task you keep pushing to tomorrow.
A lucky break may show up today. Read the details before you jump.
Your opinions are sharp today. Share one; save the rest for lunch.
Small pleasures hit hard today. Get the good bubble tea, full sugar.
Someone wants the same seat today. Share the table; it's not a race.
Your people get you today. Send the voice note; they'll reply fast.
